<p class="card-kicker">The Loop · 2023</p>

### A Case for Democracy's Digital Playground

Democratic institutions need protected spaces for experimentation if they are to adapt to the pressures of the digital age. The essay outlines an artificial world where institutional mechanisms can compete, fail cheaply, and improve, starting with small-scale educational applications.

[Read at The Loop](https://theloop.ecpr.eu/a-case-for-democracys-digital-playground/)
:::
